pr_title: Add warning for BIDI characters in page renders and in diffs
pr_body:
Fix #17514

Given the comments I've adjusted this somewhat. The numbers of characters detected are increased and include things like the use of U+300 to make à instead of à and non-breaking spaces.

There is a button which can be used to escape the content to show it.

## Rendered page header when hidden characters are detected
![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 10-58-18](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101128-e6b72da3-7fd5-4bf7-85b1-f97c19417fed.png)

![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-01-44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101598-e3c316bd-d066-4820-92ee-f17be024ffde.png)


## Rendered page when BiDi characters are detected on lines only containing LTR characters

![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-02-44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101736-1036f26d-1c9c-4fae-9788-fb9f18c4ab3e.png)


![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-03-04](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101794-02ee83f7-988e-4056-ad4d-6b3c343553df.png)

## Diff view 

Diff view is escaped by default

![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-03-48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101904-63207978-d60f-48bf-b6d2-675979b966c3.png)

but can be unescaped:

![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-04-29](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141101999-e6a5597e-9308-4232-b8e6-00302fa09783.png)


## Diff Split view

![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-07-03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141102345-59805ed3-4e5f-44d3-9f81-629c266e72aa.png)

with unescape as above

## Blame view 
![Screenshot from 2021-11-10 11-07-46](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/141102476-4f4a15c1-97b4-49ff-aac5-b7cd5b281081.png)

unescape as above.

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>

issue_context.title: Warn on bidirectional Unicode text (CVE-2021-42574)
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

After the public disclosure of [CVE-2021-42574](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2021/11/01/cve-2021-42574.html), [Github now displays a warning](https://github.blog/changelog/2021-10-31-warning-about-bidirectional-unicode-text/) when a file's contents include bidirectional Unicode text in order to mitigate the effects of the flaw.

It would be nice if Gitea could implement similar functionality.

### Screenshots

_No response_
comments: This is a big deal for development teams looking to mitigate risk related to CVE-2021-42574. Proper code review is considerably harder without a feature like this in place.

For the wording of warning message, I suggest:

```
This file contains hidden Unicode characters that may be processed differently from what appears below.
If your use case is intentional and legitimate, you can safely ignore this warning. Consult documentation
of your favorite text editor for how to open this file using `DOS (CP 437)` encoding instead of Unicode,
to reveal hidden characters.
```

review_comments: This could be simplified to a uint32
I don't think flagging this would be a good idea.
